decks.notes: This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast. The deck also utilizes cards like The Akroan War and Reckless Stormseeker to further pressure the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and utility. The deck aims to quickly apply pressure and close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize, making it a formidable force in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matchups.

The deck focuses on using green mana-producing creatures and enchantments to ramp up quickly and play powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also utilizes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship for added value and removal. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and utilize the devotion to green mechanic to power up Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx for even more mana generation. The deck also includes some mana fixing and protection with cards like Oath of Nissa and Boseiju, Who Endures.

The deck focuses on using Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing for explosive plays with cards like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. The key strategy involves tutoring for combo pieces, untapping Lotus Field with Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands, and casting powerful spells like Bala Ged Recovery or Sea Gate Restoration for additional advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its mana advantage and combo potential, utilizing a mix of ramp, card draw, and combo pieces to execute its game plan effectively.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on using creatures like Mayhem Devil and Bloodtithe Harvester to deal damage to opponents while also utilizing Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven for value and control. Claim the Firstborn and Fatal Push help disrupt opponents' strategies, while Thoughtseize allows for proactive disruption. The deck also includes Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger for additional pressure. The mana base is optimized for consistent performance, with a few utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Hive of the Eye Tyrant for added versatility. Overall, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays and strategic sacrifices.

The main concept of this deck is to swarm the battlefield with small, aggressive white creatures and pump them up with creature anthem effects. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant help disrupt opponents while boosting the team. Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Coppercoat Vanguard provide powerful win conditions. Brave the Elements protects against removal spells, while Ossification can turn a creature into an indestructible threat. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, aggressive strategy while maintaining board presence with resilient creatures.

This deck focuses on rapidly ramping up green mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to cast powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a large number of threats early in the game, while also utilizing cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival to maintain card advantage and board presence. Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional utility and protection, making this deck a formidable force in aggro matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and Oath of Nissa, in order to cast powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn. The deck also utilizes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival to search for key pieces and provide additional value. Additionally, cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner help to generate extra mana and draw cards. The overall goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence and efficient mana usage.

The key concept of this deck is to build a fast and aggressive board presence using low-cost creatures and efficient removal spells. The deck focuses on generating value from cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to continually pump up the power of its creatures. It also includes cards like Declaration in Stone and Skyclave Apparition for targeted removal, while Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale provide additional utility and resiliency. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its relentless aggression and efficient creatures, utilizing the white color's synergy and resilience.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Greasefang Parhelion combo to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and generate value through various spells and abilities. It includes cards like Grisly Salvage and Thoughtseize to dig for combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot provide additional threats on the board, supported by Witherbloom Command for removal and card advantage. The deck aims to assemble the combo quickly and efficiently, using a mix of creature and spell-based interactions to control the game state.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to play powerful green devotion cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Karn, the Great Creator and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner provide additional utility and card advantage in the deck. Storm the Festival allows for searching out more creatures and Boseiju, Who Endures protects against counterspells. Lair of the Hydra and Polukranos Reborn provide strong finishers for the deck, creating a fast-paced and aggressive strategy centered around green devotion.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It includes low mana cost creatures with haste and impactful spells like Atarka's Command and Play with Fire to deal damage efficiently. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain that pressure throughout the game. It also includes some versatile creatures like Kari Zev, Skyship Raider and Samut, Vizier of Naktamun to provide additional threats. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around delivering consistent damage and closing out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through countering opponent's spells, board wipes, and card advantage. Utilizing cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, Dovin's Veto, and Memory Deluge, the deck aims to maintain control of the board while generating card advantage to outvalue opponents. The inclusion of Shark Typhoon and other finishers like Hall of Storm Giants and Make Disappear allows for closing out games once control is established. The deck also includes a companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, for additional value and flexibility in deck building.

The deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects to gain incremental advantage and control the board, while also dealing direct damage to the opponent through abilities like Mayhem Devil and Bloodtithe Harvester. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of threats and removal spells, using synergies between cards like Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven to maintain a strong board presence. The inclusion of companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an additional layer of consistency and value to the deck's overall game plan.

This deck focuses on aggressive play and sacrificing creatures for value. It utilizes cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Claim the Firstborn to create an engine of sacrificing and dealing damage to the opponent. The deck also has disruption in the form of Thoughseize and Fatal Push to control the board and keep the pressure on the opponent. With a mix of sacrifice outlets, removal spells, and aggressive threats, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently in a one-on-one Pioneer format.

The main idea of this UW Control deck is to establish control over the game by countering opponent's spells, disrupting their strategies, and removing threats from the board. The deck focuses on card advantage through draw spells like Memory Deluge and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, while also utilizing cards like Shark Typhoon and Dream Trawler for additional threats. The deck also includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Hengegate Pathway to further enhance its control capabilities and protect its win conditions.

The deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, using low-cost creatures like Ornithopter and Thraben Inspector to quickly establish a board presence. It also utilizes token generation and pump effects like Venerated Loxodon and Resolute Reinforcements to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures. The deck also includes removal spells like Gleeful Demolition to deal with opposing threats. The mana base is built to support a fast and consistent curve, with a mix of red and white lands to ensure smooth mana production. Overall, the deck aims to quickly build a strong offensive position and close out the game before the opponent can establish their game plan.
